label: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Relay-1CH-U — MQTT Parc (pool satellite)

explicit.comment: Onboard isolated relay (NO, ≤10 A 250 VAC / 30 VDC) — GPIO1. Pilot a contactor for motors.
Aux DI on SH1.0 GPIO2 — flow switch, interlock, or spare.

notes: DIN-rail Wi-Fi satellite for pool loads (dose pump, heater enable, one light zone, pump-contactor coil). Flash firmware/waveshare-esp32s3-relay-parc. /setup AP PeakLogic-Relay1CH. Prefer ESP32-S3-Relay-1CH-U + external antenna at the equipment pad. Bind pool tag via PEAKLOGIC_POOL_WAVESHARE_RELAYS or Drivers → retarget DOSE_*/LIGHT_Z*/PUMP_RUN_CMD to this driver (channel R1). See docs/WAVESHARE_ESP32S3_RELAY_POOL.md.
